functions.name: DETECT
functions.label: Detect rising water
functions.description: A sensor, tag, ranger device or partner system detects an event that crosses a threshold and forms a short, time-stamped priority message.

functions.name: TRANSMIT to satellite
functions.label: Transmit to satellite
functions.description: The terminal sends the message to a satellite overhead, directly or through the nearest ranger-station tower when it sits under canopy.

functions.name: SEND to database
functions.label: Send to database
functions.description: The satellite downlinks to the nearest gateway; the regional database stores it, filters duplicates and forwards it to the Kinshasa hub, where it appears on the common operating picture (COP). Each node keeps a replica.

functions.name: PROCESS, evaluate threat
functions.label: Process, evaluate threat
functions.description: Hub analysts and models fuse the event with other data (radar, weather, history) and decide whether it is a threat, where, and who is at risk.

functions.name: AUTHORIZE
functions.label: Authorize
functions.description: The responsible national agency approves the alert and issues it as a CAP message. S-3 never decides; it only carries.

functions.name: RETRANSMIT to satellite
functions.label: Retransmit to satellite
functions.description: The hub validates the CAP message, converts it to speech in the district's languages, sets the geo-target area and uplinks it to the broadcast satellite.

functions.name: SEND to outposts
functions.label: Send to outposts
functions.description: Community receivers and ranger-station loudspeakers inside the target area wake up and play the alert aloud; ranger terminals get the text.

functions.name: VERIFICATION
functions.label: Verification
functions.description: Ranger stations confirm the alert was heard (receiver check-ins, patrols, the tower loudspeaker) and report ground truth; the acknowledgment returns over the satellite link and closes the loop to F4.
